# Hong Kong to Shenzhen Electric Road Trip — Family-Friendly EV Itinerary

Hong Kong and Shenzhen — two of the most dynamic cities in Asia, separated by just 30 km of water and connected by a handful of bridges and tunnels. Driving an EV between them in 2026 is not just possible; it's the smartest way for a family to explore the Greater Bay Area. With Shenzhen's world-class charging infrastructure and Hong Kong's growing network, a cross-border EV road trip is a perfect weekend adventure.

This guide covers everything: what you need for cross-border driving, charging stations in both cities, family-friendly activities at each stop, and how to make the most of your electric weekend.

## Key Takeaways

- The Hong Kong–Shenzhen journey is **30-45 minutes** driving (excluding border crossing time) — among the shortest international EV road trips in Asia
- Total charging cost for a weekend: approximately **HKD 200-350 ($26-45 USD)** — compared to HKD 600+ for petrol
- **Shenzhen has over 160,000 public charging points** — one of the densest EV networks in the world
- Hong Kong EV charging is improving: **CLP and Shell Recharge** now operate 60+ fast-charging stations across the city
- **Estimated driving + charging time for a weekend:** 4-6 hours total (including border processing)

## Cross-Border Requirements

### What You Need to Drive from Hong Kong to Shenzhen

**Hong Kong vehicle license + cross-border permit:** Your HK-registered EV needs a Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau vehicle permit. Cost: HKD 4,000-6,000 (one-time) + annual fee.

**Chinese temporary driver's license:** ~RMB 50 at Vehicle Management Office near Huanggang or Shenzhen Bay Port.

**Chinese insurance:** Minimum third-party liability, ~RMB 1,000/year.

**GB/T adapter:** Hong Kong uses CCS2/Type 2; mainland uses GB/T. HKD 800-1,500.

**ETC tag:** For expressway tolls in Guangdong.

> **Important:** Cross-border permits have a quota — 8-12 week wait. No permit? Park at HK border and take the MTR across.

### Easier Alternative: Rent an EV on the Mainland Side

1. Take MTR from Hong Kong to **Shenzhen Futian Station** (14 min from Admiralty)
2. Rent an EV from Shenzhou or eHi — ~**RMB 200-400/day**
3. Already has GB/T, green plate, and insurance

## EV Charging in Hong Kong

**CLP Power:** 40+ stations, 50-120 kW DC, HKD 3.50/kWh
**Shell Recharge:** 20+ stations, 60-150 kW DC, HKD 3.80/kWh
**Tesla Supercharger:** 8 stations (200+ stalls), up to 250 kW, free for Tesla
**HK Electric:** Hong Kong Island + Lantau, 50-100 kW DC, HKD 3.20/kWh

**Best pre-crossing charge:** CLP Mega Box in Kowloon Bay — 8x CCS2 120 kW, ice skating, playground.

### Top Family-Friendly Charging Spots in HK

**Kowloon Bay — Mega Box (CLP 120kW):** 8x CCS2, ice skating, playground, cinema
**Tsing Yi — Maritime Square (Shell 150kW):** 4x CCS2, mall, Tsing Yi Park playground
**Shatin — New Town Plaza (CLP 100kW):** 6x CCS2, indoor play areas, Snoopy's World
**Tuen Mun Town Plaza (HK Electric 60kW):** 4x CCS2, beach, ferry pier
**Ocean Park (CLP 50kW):** 2x CCS2, Ocean Park theme park with pandas

## EV Charging in Shenzhen

Shenzhen — **EV charging capital of the world** (100% electric public transit since 2017).

**TELD:** 3,000+ stations, 60-180 kW DC, RMB 0.80-1.50/kWh
**Star Charge:** 2,500+ stations, 60-120 kW DC, RMB 0.70-1.20/kWh
**BYD:** 1,000+ stations, 60-120 kW DC, RMB 0.60-1.00/kWh
**State Grid:** 500+ stations, 60-180 kW DC, RMB 0.90-1.30/kWh

### Best Family-Friendly Charging Spots in Shenzhen

**KK Mall — Luohu:** TELD 120kW, 8 slots. Indoor playground, 500m from border.
**MixC World — Nanshan:** Star Charge 120kW, 12 slots. Largest mall, indoor playland.
**COCO Park — Futian:** TELD 120kW, 6 slots. Outdoor kids' play area, cinema.
**OCT Bay — Nanshan:** Star Charge 60kW, 8 slots. Waterfront dining, aquarium.
**Shenzhen Safari Park:** TELD 120kW, 6 slots. Zoo — charge while you explore.
**Window of the World:** State Grid 120kW, 10 slots. Miniature landmarks theme park.
**Shenzhen Bay Park:** Star Charge 60kW, 4 slots. 15 km coastal promenade, bikes.

## Weekend Itinerary: Hong Kong to Shenzhen to Hong Kong

### Day 1: Hong Kong Departure to Shenzhen Arrival

**Morning (7-9 AM):** Depart HK hotel. Battery 80%+. Use **Shenzhen Bay Port**. Toll: HKD 50 bridge + RMB 20 expressway.

**Border crossing (9-10:30 AM):** 30-60 min at Shenzhen Bay Port. Leave before 8 AM.

**Arrival charge (10:30-11:30 AM):** Haiya Mega Mall, 5 min from port. TELD 120kW. 25-35 min. ~RMB 30-50.

**Late morning (11:30 AM-1 PM):** Shenzhen Bay Park — free entry, kids run on grass. Bike rental RMB 40/hr.

**Lunch (1-2:30 PM):** OCT Bay — Haidilao hotpot with kids' playroom. Charge at Star Charge 60kW while dining.

**Afternoon (2:30-5:30 PM):** Shenzhen Children's Palace — planetarium, earthquake simulator, hands-on science. Free entry.

**Evening (5:30-8 PM):** MixC World — dinner at Food Street (B1). Kids' play area 3rd floor. Charge at Star Charge 120kW while shopping.

**Overnight:** Ritz-Carlton Shenzhen or InterContinental Shenzhen. Both have EV charging. Filter [Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Shenzhen&filter=ev_charging).

### Day 2: Explore Shenzhen and Return to HK

**Morning (8-10 AM):** Unplug at 100%. Drive 25 min to **Shenzhen Safari Park** — pandas, elephants. Book on [Klook](https://www.klook.com/activity/). Charge at TELD 120kW.

**Lunch (12:30-1:30 PM):** Panda Restaurant at zoo.

**Afternoon (1:30-4 PM):** **Window of the World** — miniature landmarks. Tickets RMB 220/adult. Book on Klook.

**Late afternoon (4-5:30 PM):** **Dongmen Pedestrian Street** — street food: bubble tea, grilled squid. Kids' arcade Dongmen Mall.

**Evening (5:30-7:30 PM):** Top up at TELD KK Mall (Luohu). 5 min from Lo Wu checkpoint. Dinner 5th floor kids' dining zone.

**Return (7:30-9 PM):** Lo Wu/Luohu Port (open until 12 AM). 30-60 min customs.

## Cost Breakdown (Weekend, Family of 4)

**Charging:** HKD 160-270 | **Tolls:** HKD 80-100 | **Meals:** HKD 600-1,000
**Attractions:** HKD 600-800 | **Hotel:** HKD 800-1,500 | **Total:** ~$290-470 USD

## Pro Tips

**HK-Side:** Charge to 100% night before. Download WeChat and Alipay. Buy China SIM at Lo Wu.

**Driving in SZ:** Use Baidu Maps or Amap. Green plate = free parking + bus lane access.

**Border:** Shenzhen Bay Port 6:30 AM-12 AM. Huanggang 24h. Lo Wu 6 AM-12 AM. Avoid Fri ev/Mon morning.

faq.question: Can I drive a Hong Kong EV to Shenzhen without paperwork?
faq.answer: No. You need a cross-border permit (8-12 week wait), Chinese insurance, and temporary license. Alternative: park in HK and rent an EV in Shenzhen.

faq.question: Is Shenzhen's EV infrastructure good for tourists?
faq.answer: World-class — 160,000+ public points. Use TELD or Star Charge via WeChat with Alipay linked to international card.

faq.question: What family activities does Shenzhen offer?
faq.answer: Shenzhen Safari Park, Window of the World, Shenzhen Bay Park, Children's Palace science centre, and massive family-friendly malls.

faq.question: How long does border crossing take?
faq.answer: 30-60 minutes on normal weekends. Avoid Friday evening and Monday morning peak.
